Ray Marching - Rendering Without Triangles Using Distance Fields | KipuHub
Dec 14, 2024Try It The canvas below shows a 2D cross-section of a ray marching scene. The orange dot is the ray origin; the black arrow shows the ray direction. The colored circles are the SDF "safe spheres" — at each step the ray may advance by the radius of the circle centered on the current position, guaranteed not to overshoot the nearest obstacle.
